_comment: PLACEHOLDER numbers for dry runs and tests, not measurements. The pilot overwrites every value: kv_bytes_per_token from the model config, engine_rss_bytes as the peak RSS of a C0 run beyond the pinned CPU tier, prefill_tok_s as the engine's measured prefill rate at each load, wt_offered_write_Bps as write-through's offered write rate at each load (bytes written to the tier per second in a T run with no disk limit).
